title: 第二十六章 上古小秘境
slug: 穿书被杀妻证道魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这话听着莫名有些怪异，谢清猗不自觉地颦蹙起眉头，嗓音里有自己不自知的娇柔，下意识解释着：“你乱讲，不许污蔑我，我才不愿与他一路。”

她顿了顿，似乎不能只说这一句，也不知自己为何要解释这么多：“之前在飞舟上，我便极力避着和他一路，是他非要拉着我不放。”

话一出口，心头竟莫名一松，却也来不及细想自己刚刚为何怕对方误解。

玉简那头静默了片刻，再次响起的声音里，那冷硬的语气似乎融化了些许，声音里带着一丝几不可察的轻笑：“嗯。我来秘境寻你。”

听闻他要来，谢清猗心口一跳，唇角不自觉微微扬起，带上了未察觉的关切：“那你，务必小心，外头的毒瘴林很危险。”

这次识海中清晰地传来慕宸一声很轻地低笑，清冽好听的嗓音在她识海中打转：“嗯，知道了。”

随即，玉简的联络便被对方干脆地掐断。

千沐妍自踏入句余山后，一路都未与谢清猗搭话，此刻见她唇边噙着一抹若有似无的笑意，终究按捺不住，语带讥诮地开口：“眼下境况凶险，多少同门已然牺牲，不知谢师姐是因何事，竟还能笑得出来？”

谢清猗只觉得眉心抽抽，自己满头问号，她转头无语的看向对方，眼神轻瞥了她一眼，女主，你有什么大病，没事找茬，就这么想和她这个恶毒女配，扯不开关系吗？

心念瞬转间，面上却依旧如寻常，她将声音略略提高，语速不急不缓：“我等此番进入秘境，若能有所斩获，拔得头筹，才不辜负仙府多年的悉心栽培，亦是对我等现阶段修行成果的最好印证。”

顿了顿，她目光坦然扫过四周弟子，最终落回千沐妍面上，继续道：“至于不幸罹难的同门，我心中自然万分沉痛。正是因我深信，在司师兄的引领下，我等必能取得秘宝，不负逝者所托，心中方觉有所依托，神色才不似那般沉重罢了。”

说罢，她刚才的发言地时候就不停的脑补，好像什么×商给人洗脑的大会，给他们打鸡血呢。随即又看向千沐妍，见对方瞥过头不看她。

她鼻腔轻轻哼了声，至于笑？她自然是绝不会承认的，只是有些气恼，这女主怎么总是盯着她啊，真晦气！

谢清猗心底掠过一丝冷嘲，面上却依旧温和，看向千沐妍道，不紧不慢地说道：“倒是千师妹，稍后若遇险境，望你稍安勿躁，行事前多思量，莫要再如先前那般，再让大家分心照看。”

Page (1/3)

These words sounded inexplicably weird. Xie Qingyi frowned unconsciously. There was a softness in his voice that he didn't know he had, and he subconsciously explained: "You are talking nonsense. Don't slander me. I don't want to be with him."

She paused, as if she couldn't just say this sentence, and she didn't know why she had to explain so much: "On the flying boat before, I tried my best to avoid being with him, but he insisted on holding me back."

As soon as the words came out, I felt inexplicably relieved, but I didn't have time to think about why I was afraid of being misunderstood.

There was silence on the other end of the jade slip for a moment. When the voice came out again, the cold tone seemed to have melted a little, and there was an almost imperceptible chuckle in the voice: "Well. I came to the secret realm to find you."

Hearing that he was coming, Xie Qingyi's heart skipped a beat, and the corners of his lips raised slightly unconsciously, with unnoticed concern: "Then you must be careful, the poisonous miasma forest outside is very dangerous."

This time, a soft chuckle from Mu Chen was clearly heard in her consciousness, and the clear and pleasant voice swirled in her consciousness: "Yes, I understand."

Immediately, Yu Jian's contact was simply cut off by the other party.

Qian Muyan hadn't spoken to Xie Qingyi all the way since she stepped into Juyu Mountain. Now she saw a faint smile on her lips. She couldn't hold it back and spoke sarcastically: "The current situation is dangerous and many of our classmates have already sacrificed. I wonder why Senior Sister Xie can still laugh?"

Xie Qingyi felt her brows twitching, and her head was full of questions. She turned to look at the other party speechlessly, and glanced at her, heroine, what's wrong with you, why are you looking for trouble? Do you really want to have nothing to do with her, a vicious female partner?

Her thoughts were fleeting, but her face remained as usual. She raised her voice slightly and spoke at a leisurely pace: "We enter the secret realm this time. If we can gain something and come out on top, we will be able to live up to the Xian Mansion's many years of careful cultivation. This will also be the best confirmation of our current cultivation achievements."

After a pause, her eyes calmly scanned the surrounding disciples, and finally returned to Qian Muyan, and continued: "As for the fellow disciples who unfortunately died, my heart is naturally very sad. It is precisely because I firmly believe that under the guidance of Senior Brother Si, we will be able to obtain the secret treasure and live up to the trust of the deceased, so I feel that I have something to rely on, and my expression is not so heavy."

Having said that, she kept thinking about what she just said, like some kind of conference where businessmen brainwash people and give them chicken blood.Then he looked at Qian Muyan and saw that the other party glanced away from her.

She snorted softly through her nose. As for laughing?Of course she would never admit it, but she was just a little annoyed. Why was the heroine always staring at her? What a bad luck!

A hint of cynicism flashed through Xie Qingyi's heart, but his face remained gentle. He looked at Qian Muyan and said unhurriedly: "Junior Sister Qian, if you are in danger later, I hope you will be calm and think carefully before acting. Don't let everyone distract you like before."
